what_happened.detected: every GANN process (parent 89110 and all 9 workers) was found in state TN — STOPPED — during a routine status check
what_happened.computation_lost: NONE — a stopped process keeps its address space; each worker still held ~149 minutes of accumulated CPU time and resumed from the same instruction
what_happened.resumed_by: SIGCONT to the parent and all workers

cause.candidate: a suspend targeting the worker process group. A SIGSTOP aimed at the GANN workers was proposed and REJECTED by the user, and a separate SIGSTOP was issued to the T9 process at about the same time; the two are adjacent in time to the stop, but the mechanism is not proven
cause.honesty_note: the cause is not established. It is recorded as undetermined rather than assigned to the most convenient explanation.

integrity.why_inert: suspension affects scheduling only; the address space, every Generator object and every completed world's result are byte-identical on resume

runtime_field_warning.problem: that field is wall clock from the process's own t0, so it will INCLUDE the ~11.8 stopped hours and must not be read as compute time
runtime_field_warning.also: the in-run 'min left' estimates printed after the resume are extrapolated from that same inflated wall clock and will be wrong until they re-converge
runtime_field_warning.compute_time_instead: per-worker CPU time is the honest measure
